nom: The Crème Shop Cinnamoroll Under Eye Patches

avis.texte: My youngest daughter is obsessed with Cinnamoroll, so I knew that I had to give these a try. A big thank you to The Crème Shop X Hello Kitty and Friends for sending me this product for free in exchange of my honest review. I have a bit of a fixation on the way product packaging feels, so right away this package caught my attention. Opening it was easy, as were the clear instructions on the back of the package. Upon removing them from the inner plastic "container" I immediately fell in love with the hydrogel. These under eye patches are not like most patches that are more papery feeling. These are so soft and smooth with just the right amount of moisture. I generally avoid under eye patches because they make me feel gross with all of the goopy liquid, but these I would most certainly use again. I have sensitive skin and allergic to nearly everything and even though upon initial application I thought that I felt a bit of a tingle (they are cooling and lavender with caffeine), I had no negative reaction. And, of course, I had to give them to my daughter right after.
The under eye patches are super cute and have a nice scent but they felt very thin and didn't feel like they did much for my skin.
Loved the product's packaging but felt too thin to do much for my skin. Had a pleasant smell, didn't feel sticky. Overall okay.
After less than 5 hours of sleep and an early airport flight to catch, this underage patch came in handy and I didn't look like I was sleep deprived when I landed. Good stuff
This product worked well.. My under eye was so hydrated and smooth after using. I will definitely be buying this product in the future.

avis.titre: Put them in the fridge to help with depuffing eyes!
avis.texte: These under eye patches are so, so cute. I put them in the fridge so they are cold when I want to use them. It helps to depuff my eyes when I wake up in the morning. It feels nice and refreshing. I also feel like my under eyes are hydrated. The price is steep for one pair though.

I put these on while working from home, trying to get a bit of beauty routine and relaxation into my work day. I can't say I saw a big difference from them, or that they were that *effective*, but the ritual of using them was nice, they did depuff my eye area (a bit?!), and I felt like I was treating myself while at work!! So, ultimately, worth it to me! And cute to boot!

avis.titre: Don't forget to peel off the plastic sheet!
avis.texte: The first thing I want to mention is that is does not say to peel off the plastic sheet in the instructions. It took me a whole 5 mins of wearing to realize this peels off. At first they were not sticking smoothly because of that layer. Once I peeled that off they stuck great. They did not burn my skin as some eye patches do. So if you have sensitive skin, these might work for you! They gave a cooling effect as I worse them which was relaxing. I was not sure I would see any "depuffing" effect, but I think I actually did. My under eyes looked and felt nice and tight and smooth afterwards. They are less messy than other eye patches I have used. All in all, I would give them a thumbs up!

These eye patches are a game changer! They feel cool and refreshing the moment you apply them, and they noticeably reduce puffiness and brighten my under eyes. Perfect for a quick pick-me-up before makeup or a relaxing self-care moment. Definitely a must-have in my skincare routine!

I received this Hello Kitty and friends hydrogel under eye patches in cimaroll and exchange for a fair and honest review. I use these after removing my makeup before bed and left them on her package instructions and felt that they need my eyes feel somewhat soothed. Allergies have been making my eyes itchy and I felt like this offered some relief to mystery kinda raw skin.

I have puffy under eyes. I'm not sure if it's due to age, lack of sleep, diet or all of the above. However regardless of the reason I do enjoy a using eye patches from time to time to pamper myself. These under eye patches definitely do the job in the cooling aspect but as far as depuffing I didn't see much of anything. Like most products consistent use is key to seeing results. I suspect I need to use them for a while before noticing a difference. One use is not enough to see any depuffing. They're cute and I did enjoy using them. But for the price I don't think they're worth it even if they're just a couple of dollars since you only get one pair and they're not reusable.
Sometimes when you buy character products they don't work well- but they're cute! Well these are cute and they work well
I put it on first thing in the morning and took the puffiness out my eyes. When applying my makeup I notice no creasing under my eyes. That's a win!

These under eye patches are not only cute but really help to de puff your eyes. There is a cool feeling when they are first applied. I do believe with continuous use, they would really help to keep the puffiness down every day. Overall they were super cute and fun to use.

avis.titre: Absolutley adorable and great for a self-care night
avis.texte: It's so cute. I'm a huge Sanrio fan, so this was right in my alley. It was like combining my love for skincare with my childlike love for Cinnamoroll! While using it, it's very cooling, although I usually put my under eye patches in the fridge for 5 minutes before applying the patches under my eyes. It's very cooling and I noticed a depuffing of the eyes. I loved it for a self-care night with a glass of wine and a movie night. I was gifted this, but I truly did enjoy this. I'm excited to get some more, and possibly look to see if they have face masks, too.
It felt like it was cooling, but I didn't look any different after I used it. It did feel nice though.
Patches were easy to apply and the instructions were easy to understand. Washed my face and enjoyed a simple and quiet 20 minute relaxtion period.

Thank you BzzAgent for sending me these free eye patches for reviewing purposes. I recently tried a pair of hydrating nighttime eye patches, and I must say, they have quickly become a staple in my evening skincare routine! From the moment I applied them, I was impressed by how serene and refreshing they felt on my skin. The patches are infused with a delightful blend of hydrating ingredients that smoothly adhere to the under-eye area. After just one use, I noticed a significant reduction in puffiness and dark circles. They left my skin feeling incredibly soft and moisturized, almost like a mini spa treatment right at home! I particularly love how easy they are to use. After cleansing my face, I simply place the patches under my eyes and let them work their magic while I wind down for the night. They're perfect for pampering yourself after a long day or before a special event. One of the best aspects of these eye patches is the soothing sensation they provide. They're cool to the touch, making them perfect for relaxation. I found my eyes looking more rejuvenated and bright in the morning, which is a huge win! If you're looking for an effective way to hydrate and refresh your under-eye area, I highly recommend giving these nighttime eye patches a try. They have certainly earned their place in my skincare regimen!

avis.titre: I would buy this eye product !!
avis.texte: The under eye treatment works really well love the cooling sensation. I use this right after a hot shower. My sample didn't really have a smell. The moisturizer is light weight and does not make me look greasy. They depuff and give you suppleness. I would buy again.
I like the package the hello kitty is super cute but didn't really impress me much it was just ok felt cooling while I had them on but didnt feel like it left my eyes hydrated.

I received this product for free in exchange for a review. I tried this on a girls night and did notice brighter moisturized undereyes! I would use these again if I find them in stores next girls night :)

These under eye patches were super easy to apply and they didn't slide down which I love because I've had that problem with other patches. Definitely a good hydrating boost and dewy after feel which was great.

I received the Hello Kitty and Friends Calming Hydrogel Under Eye Patches (Cinnamoroll) for free in exchange for my honest review—and I genuinely love them! As a pregnant mom of two, I'm always tired, and these patches give my under-eyes a much-needed boost of hydration. They feel cooling, calming, and stay in place well. Plus, the cute packaging makes the self-care moment even sweeter!

avis.titre: Cute product that brightens under eyes- would buy again
avis.texte: These under eye patches were cute and a nice texture. I don't love it when patches feel overly slimy or gross, but these were just right! They had a nice smell and seemed to brighten up my under eyes nicely. My skin felt firm and it definitely made me feel better about my eye appearance.

I recently tried the Hello Kitty and Friends Calming Hydrogel Under Eye Patches featuring Cinnamoroll, and they were both effective and adorable. The lavender and caffeine-infused patches provided a cooling sensation that helped reduce puffiness and refreshed my under-eye area in just 15 minutes. The cute Cinnamoroll design added a fun touch to my skincare routine.

They were super cute and I like the packaging a lot! The packaging made it so the patches stay in the little tray and there's plastic over the patches so your fingers don't have to touch them. I also liked that the underside that went on my face felt like a sheet mask but still jelly. My only complaint is that they didn't seem very wet so they dried on my quicker than the instructed 15 minutes and there was no liquid product left in the packaging to re wet.

Often eye patches burn for me but this was not the case. They were very hydrating and felt soothing. They also stayed in place fairly well. The cute design is an added bonus. I am going to go to Ulta and buy some more!
I love this design. It is so cute and makes me want to use it! The eye patches are very hydrating and my eye bags looked better like I got a good night's sleep.

These eye patches are super cooling and comfortable to wear. They feel so good under the eyes and helped me depuff after waking up in the morning to prep my skin for makeup. Not to mention super cute packaging and pattern.

I received the Hello Kitty and Friends' Hydrogel Under Eye Patches-Cinnamon Roll for free in exchange for my honest review. I loved the packaging on this product, it's super cute. I used the patches prior you putting on makeup . They brightened my undereyes and helped with puffiness. They were also hydrating. My undereye concealer went on very smooth with no creasing after applying the patches. Would def use again.
These patches have a very cooling affect. Definitely hydrates the under eye and have a soothing feeling
I loved these eye patches. They were so easy to apply and stayed on once they were applied. They peeled nicely and weren't slimy. They looked so cute when they were on and the smell was enjoyable.

avis.titre: Super cute and forms to skin nicely
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. The Cinnamoroll design was super cute and while that zero impact on hydrating my dry under eyes, it just picked up my mood. The under eye patches formed to my skin well, but I do wish they were more hydrating.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again!
avis.texte: It had a really nice cooling effect and felt very hydrating. I loved it!

avis.titre: Fun for a face mask night!
avis.texte: Felt fine underneath the eyes, but didn't improve the under eye region anymore than a good moisturizer. Definitely fun if you're looking to relax with cute face masks, but in my opinion, not worth purchasing multiple for regular use. Nothing bad to say, but nothing supremely positive. Cute though!

I received these eye patches in exchange for writing a detailed, honest review of my experience. I am extremely impressed with the quality and results I experienced with this product. The Hello Kitty & Friends Hydrogel Under Eye Patches - Cinnamoroll claim to be cooling and reduce puffiness on the packaging (puffiness is a big issue for me!) and they absolutely delivered. Within the 15 minutes of applying the product to my under eye I had noticeably less puffiness. Overall I was extremely impressed and intend to purchase more of these patches in the future.

I received the opportunity to try out Hello Kitty and Friends' Hydrogel Under Eye Patches-Cinnamon Roll for free in exchange for my honest review. These under eye patches help reduce puffiness and tired eyes as they are formulated with caffeine. They also have lavender in them which offers a nice cooling sensation. I am a fan of Hello Kitty and these patches are super cute! I wish they could be used a few times so I have repacked them back in the foil to see if I can get a few more uses out of them. Overall I'm a fan and would recommend them especially for Hello Kitty lovers.

I love creme shop eye patches they are the literal best. They're the only form of under eye patch that actually looks like it's made a difference after I use it. These made my genetic under eye bags look lifted and actually refreshed.
